verdict.rationale: Rootly documents an official MCP server that exposes its incident data and actions as tools for any MCP-compatible client, naming Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code and Gemini CLI. Documented tools cover querying incidents, checking on-call schedules, finding similar incidents via find_related_incidents, and taking action, and a probe confirms the official docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and explicit setup/authentication steps for connecting a client (API key generation is documented only separately).
